title.zh: US Core PCE Price Index Falls to 3% in August, Lowest Since February
title.en: US Core PCE Price Index Falls to 3% in August, Lowest Since February

current_state.zh: US core PCE inflation cooled to 3.0% year-over-year in August — the lowest since February — and rose just 0.2% month-over-month, both below consensus forecasts of 3.3% and 0.3%.
current_state.en: US core PCE inflation cooled to 3.0% year-over-year in August — the lowest since February — and rose just 0.2% month-over-month, both below consensus forecasts of 3.3% and 0.3%.
